# Forward Projection — Year Ahead Fixture

## 12-Month Scenario Map

**Baseline scenario (55 %):** EP legislative programme delivers Commission Work Programme 2026 core priorities. Trio Presidency (Poland → Denmark → Cyprus) maintains institutional continuity. No snap elections or major coalition realignment.

**Upside scenario (25 %):** Defence Fund disbursement accelerates; AI Act delegated acts adopted on schedule; CBAM phase-in completes without third-country retaliation. EP-Commission co-legislative momentum highest in EP10 term.

**Downside scenario (20 %):** US-EU trade dispute escalation triggers EP emergency procedures, displacing planned legislative calendar. Geopolitical shock (Ukraine ceasefire collapse) forces budget re-prioritisation.

## 12-Month Forward Indicators

- Plenary sessions: 12 scheduled (monthly Strasbourg + Brussels supplementary sessions).
- Flagship trilogues: 4 near-conclusion, 6 in active negotiation, 3 mandate phase.
- Presidency handovers: 2 (Poland → Denmark July, Denmark → Cyprus December).
